# Country launch dossier

Status: template. One dossier per destination and supply model.

| Field | Decision/evidence |
|---|---|
| Country, territory and planned launch date | |
| Customer segments and B2B/B2C model | |
| Legal seller, establishment and local service contacts | |
| Approved product families and exact SKU list | |
| Manufacturer/representative/device importer/distributor roles | |
| Device conformity, transition and EUDAMED requirements | |
| Separate medicine/veterinary/biocide/PPE permissions | |
| Label/IFU/safety language requirements and translations | |
| Supplier territorial/channel resale permissions | |
| Warehouse, customs importer, EORI and Incoterms | |
| Customs code, origin, duty, broker and clearance costs | |
| VAT registrations, B2B evidence, OSS/IOSS applicability | |
| Currency, payment acceptance and settlement | |
| Gross/net/unit pricing and mandatory charges | |
| Shipping zones, restricted classes, promises and returns | |
| Warranty, installation, calibration and local service | |
| Consumer terms, cancellation, complaints and dispute routes | |
| Privacy, tracking and marketing rules | |
| Accessibility applicability and acceptance evidence | |
| Packaging EPR, WEEE and batteries; applicable registrations | |
| Product liability/recall/territorial insurance | |
| Demand evidence, acquisition plan and cohort assumptions | |
| Delivered contribution and working-capital scenarios | |
| End-to-end pilot order, return/refund and recall exercise | |
| Specialist/legal/tax reviewers and check dates | |
| Open blockers and owner | |
| Release decision, scope and next review | |

Do not activate a country simply because a carrier accepts parcels or a payment gateway accepts its currency.
